All 11 failures are i33's scenarios that no finished work-item implements yet: the 10 from review 6, plus @r120, which has no step definition (i33's w194 covers it).

  - w189's tests: 9 passed.

  - Import contracts: the project states none, so I checked the module map by hand.
  - Lint: the same 17 errors as in review 6, all Minor observations. 12 of them are in helper scripts committed under `.shop/`.
